arxiv-2106-03234.title: A call for better unit testing for Invariant Risk Minimisation
arxiv-2106-03234.creator: Chunyang Xiao, Pranava Madhyastha, Email: cxiao35@bloomberg.net, pranava@imperial.ac.uk
arxiv-2106-03234.description: Abstract In this paper we present a controlled study on the linearized IRM framework (IRMv1) introduced in Arjovsky et al. 2020 . We show that IRMv1 (and its variants) framework can be potentially unstable under small changes to the optimal regressor.

arxiv-2204-09729.title: GRB Prompt Emission: Observed Correlations and Their Interpretations
arxiv-2204-09729.creator: Tyler Parsotan, Hirotaka Ito
arxiv-2204-09729.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tyler Parsotan, Hirotaka Ito. The prompt emission of Gamma Ray Bursts (GRBs) is still an outstanding question in the study of these cataclysmic events. Part of what makes GRBs difficult to study is how unique each event seems to be. However, aggregating many GRB observations and analyzing the population allows us to obtain a better understanding of the emission mechanism that produces the observed prompt emission.

arxiv-2210-07117.title: Graph-based Neural Modules to Inspect Attention-based Architectures: A Position Paper
arxiv-2210-07117.creator: Breno W. Carvalho, Artur S. d’Avila Garcez, Luís C. Lamb
arxiv-2210-07117.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Breno W. Carvalho, Artur S. d’Avila Garcez, Luís C. Lamb. Encoder-decoder architectures are prominent building blocks of state-of-the-art solutions for tasks across multiple fields where deep learning (DL) or foundation models play a key role.

arxiv-2210-08888.title: Modelling the impact of repeat asymptomatic testing policies for staff on SARS-CoV-2 transmission potential
arxiv-2210-08888.creator: Carl A. Whitfield, University of Manchester COVID-19 Modelling Group, Ian Hall
arxiv-2210-08888.description: Abstract Repeat asymptomatic testing in order to identify and quarantine infectious individuals has become a widely-used intervention to control SARS-CoV-2 transmission. In some workplaces, and in particular health and social care settings with vulnerable patients, regular asymptomatic testing has been deployed to staff to reduce the likelihood of workplace outbreaks.

arxiv-2211-11928.title: A case study of proactive auto-scaling for an ecommerce workload
arxiv-2211-11928.creator: Marcella Medeiros Siqueira Coutinho de Almeida, Thiago Emmanuel Pereira, Fabio Morais
arxiv-2211-11928.description: Abstract . Preliminary data obtained from a partnership between the Federal University of Campina Grande and an ecommerce company indicates that some applications have issues when dealing with variable demand. This happens because a delay in scaling resources leads to performance degradation and, in literature, is a matter usually treated by improving the auto-scaling.

arxiv-2310-10606.title: BayRnTune: Adaptive Bayesian Domain Randomization via Strategic Fine-tuning
arxiv-2310-10606.creator: Tianle Huang Nitish Sontakke K. Niranjan Kumar Irfan Essa, Stefanos Nikolaidis Dennis W. Hong Sehoon Ha
arxiv-2310-10606.description: Abstract Domain randomization (DR), which entails training a policy with randomized dynamics, has proven to be a simple yet effective algorithm for reducing the gap between simulation and the real world. However, DR often requires careful tuning of randomization parameters.

arxiv-2310-11494.title: String Thermodynamics In and Out of Equilibrium: Boltzmann Equations and Random Walks
arxiv-2310-11494.creator: Andrew R. Frey, Ratul Mahanta, Anshuman Maharana, Francesco Muia, Fernando Quevedo, Gonzalo Villa
arxiv-2310-11494.description: Abstract We revisit the study of string theory close to the Hagedorn temperature with the aim towards cosmological applications. We consider interactions of open and closed strings in a gas of D p − p- branes, and/or one isolated D p p -brane, in an arbitrary number d d of flat non-compact dimensions and general compact dimensions.

arxiv-2408-00247.title: Simple but Efficient: A Multi-Scenario Nearline Retrieval Framework for Recommendation on Taobao
arxiv-2408-00247.creator: Yingcai Ma, Ziyang Wang, Yuliang Yan, Jian Wu, Yuning Jiang, Longbin Li, Wen Chen, Jianhang Huang
arxiv-2408-00247.description: Abstract . In recommendation systems, the matching stage is becoming increasingly critical, serving as the upper limit for the entire recommendation process. Recently, some studies have started to explore the use of multi-scenario information for recommendations, such as model-based and data-based approaches.

arxiv-2409-06767.title: Black hole–neutron star binaries with high spins and large mass asymmetries: I. Properties of quasi-equilibrium sequences
arxiv-2409-06767.creator: Konrad Topolski, Samuel D. Tootle, Luciano Rezzolla
arxiv-2409-06767.description: Abstract Black hole – neutron star (BHNS) mergers are a promising target of current gravitational-wave (GW) and electromagnetic (EM) searches, being the putative origin of ultra-relativistic jets, gamma-ray emission, and r-process nucleosynthesis. However, the possibility of any EM emission accompanying a GW detection crucially depends on the amount of baryonic mass left after the coalescence, i.e.

arxiv-2409-07315.title: Integrating Bayesian Approaches and Expert Knowledge for Forecasting Continuous Glucose Monitoring Values in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
arxiv-2409-07315.creator: Yuyang Sun, Panagiotis Kosmas
arxiv-2409-07315.description: Abstract Precise and timely forecasting of blood glucose levels is essential for effective diabetes management. While extensive research has been conducted on Type 1 diabetes mellitus, Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) presents unique challenges due to its heterogeneity, underscoring the need for specialized blood glucose forecasting systems.

arxiv-2411-01813.title: So You Think You Can Scale Up Autonomous Robot Data Collection?
arxiv-2411-01813.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . A long-standing goal in robot learning is to develop methods for robots to acquire new skills autonomously. While reinforcement learning (RL) comes with the promise of enabling autonomous data collection, it remains challenging to scale in the real-world partly due to the significant effort required for environment design and instrumentation, including the need for designing reset functions or accurate success detectors.

arxiv-2411-15236.title: Text Embedding is Not All You Need: Attention Control for Text-to-Image Semantic Alignment with Text Self-Attention Maps
arxiv-2411-15236.creator: Jeeyung Kim, Erfan Esmaeili, Qiang QiuPurdue University {jkim17, efakhabi, qqiu}@purdue.edu
arxiv-2411-15236.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jeeyung Kim, Erfan Esmaeili, Qiang QiuPurdue University {jkim17, efakhabi, qqiu}@purdue.edu. In text-to-image diffusion models, the cross-attention map of each text token indicates the specific image regions attended. Comparing these maps of syntactically related tokens provides insights into how well the generated image reflects the text prompt. For example, in the prompt, “a black car and a white clock”, the cross-attention maps for “black” and “car” should focus on overlapping regions to depict a black car, while “car” and “clock” should not.

arxiv-2504-05483.title: Secure Diagnostics: Adversarial Robustness Meets Clinical Interpretability
arxiv-2504-05483.creator: Mohammad Hossein Najafi, Mohammad Morsali, Mohammadreza Pashanejad, Saman Soleimani Roudi, Mohammad Norouzi, Saeed Bagheri Shouraki
arxiv-2504-05483.description: Abstract Deep neural networks for medical image classification often fail to generalize consistently in clinical practice due to violations of the i.i.d. assumption and opaque decision-making. This paper examines interpretability in deep neural networks fine-tuned for fracture detection by evaluating model performance against adversarial attack and comparing interpretability methods to fracture regions annotated by an orthopedic surgeon.

arxiv-2507-11261.title: ViewSRD: 3D Visual Grounding via Structured Multi-View Decomposition
arxiv-2507-11261.creator: Ronggang Huang, Haoxin Yang, Yan Cai, Xuemiao Xu, Huaidong Zhang, Shengfeng He
arxiv-2507-11261.description: Abstract 3D visual grounding aims to identify and localize objects in a 3D space based on textual descriptions. However, existing methods struggle with disentangling targets from anchors in complex multi-anchor queries and resolving inconsistencies in spatial descriptions caused by perspective variations.

pmc-10653713.title: Prevalence of Sodium Glucose Cotransporter 2 (SGLT-2) Inhibitor Prescribing in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Reduced Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate
pmc-10653713.creator: Kayla Chonko, Giavanna Russo-Alvarez, Diana Isaacs, Lu Wang, Amanda Soric
pmc-10653713.description: Sodium glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT-2) inhibitors have demonstrated benefit in people with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and chronic kidney disease (CKD), including slowing the progression of CKD and lowering the risk of kidney failure and death. Despite this evidence, literature suggests SGLT-2 inhibitors are underutilized in this population.

pmc-11379614.title: Systemic innovation for operationalising bioeconomy: A qualitative content analysis
pmc-11379614.creator: Laura Carraresi
pmc-11379614.description: The purpose of the paper is to explore the attributes of systemic innovation that align with bioeconomy. The potential of systemic innovation, an overarching concept based on cooperation and integration along and across (emerging) value chains, to drive transitions towards bioeconomy has received limited attention. Therefore, this study aims to address this gap in knowledge.

pmc-11473639.title: Nrf-2/HO-1 activation protects against oxidative stress and inflammation induced by metal welding fume UFPs in 16HBE cells
pmc-11473639.creator: Mengchao Ying, Yun Yang, Qian Huo, Jingqiu Sun, Xinyu Hong, Feng Yang, Yamin Fang, Lingyi Lu, Tingfeng Mao, Ping Xiao, Gonghua Tao
pmc-11473639.description: As one of the main occupational hazards, welding fumes can cause oxidative damage and induce series of diseases, such as COPD or asthma. To clarify the effects of the metal fume ultrafine particulates (MF-UFPs) of welding fumes on oxidative damage, UFPs were collected by melt inert gas (MIG) and manual metal arc (MMA) welding, and the composition was confirmed.

pmc-12541951.title: Association between self-reported gender-based discrimination and maternal mortality rates: results of an ecological multi-level analysis across nine countries in Sub-Saharan Africa
pmc-12541951.creator: Clara Orduhan, Ruth Waitzberg, Manuela De Allegri, Bona Chitah, Jean-Paul Dossou, Charlestine Bob Elwange, Adama Faye, Sharon Fonn, Christabel Kambala, Shafiu Mohammed, Hamidou Niangaly, Chenjerai Sisimayi, Wilm Quentin
pmc-12541951.description: BackgroundSub-Saharan Africa suffers from the highest maternal mortality ratio (MMR) in the world, with 542 deaths per 100,000 live births in 2017, relative to a global ratio of 211. Reducing gender-based discrimination (GBD) and increasing the empowerment of women and girls have recently been recognized as prerequisites for improving maternal health.

pmc-12804726.title: Hybrid 3D-printed/electrospun scaffolds drive myogenic differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs)
pmc-12804726.creator: Silvia Pisani, Stefania Marconi, Valeria Mauri, Beatrice Rossetti, Aleksandra Evangelista, Giovanna Bruni, Marco Benazzo, Ferdinando Auricchio, Bice Conti
pmc-12804726.description: The development of functional scaffolds that support cell differentiation and tissue regeneration remains a major challenge in regenerative medicine. In this study, we designed and fabricated hybrid scaffolds (HS) composed of poly(lactic-co-caprolactone) (PLA-PCL) by integrating 3D extrusion-based printing and electrospinning techniques.

pmc-13048907.title: Fiber inclusion strategies in broiler diets: effects on performance, modulation of gut microbiota and sensory properties of meat
pmc-13048907.creator: Margarida Jorge Farias, Cláudia Goulart de Abreu, Silvana Cavalcante Bastos Leite, Ana Sancha Malveira Batista, Daiane Félix Santiago Mesquita, Janete Gouveia de Souza, Raquel Oliveira dos Santos Fontenelle, Felipe Dilelis, Robson Mateus Freitas Silveira
pmc-13048907.description: This study evaluated the effects of neutral detergent fiber (NDF) source and inclusion level on the performance, gut microbiota, and meat quality of slow-growing broilers. A total of 400 Naked Neck chicks were distributed across two experiments: initial (1–28 d) and growth/finishing (29–70 d).

pmc-13068668.title: Which side do you take? Instruction versus action in resolving frame of reference conflicts
pmc-13068668.creator: Christian Böffel, Matthias Joseph Becker, Jochen Müsseler
pmc-13068668.description: Previous studies of human-avatar interaction have shown that users are able to take the perspective of an avatar and act as if they were in the avatar’s place. As a result, the positions of objects are encoded from the avatar’s perspective and within the avatar’s spatial reference frame, and avatar-based compatibility effects can be observed.

pmc-13341181.title: From Risk Categories to Risk-Adapted Care: Comparing the 2025 American Thyroid Association and 2024 Korean Thyroid Association Risk Stratification Systems in Differentiated Thyroid Cancer
pmc-13341181.creator: Won Gu Kim, Mijin Kim

pmc-13439183.title: A multi-level attention CNN-transformer based framework for the detection of brain tumor using regional dual-score explainability
pmc-13439183.creator: Aryaman Kaprekar, Anjan Gudigar, U. Raghavendra, Mahesh Anil Inamdar, Massimo Salvi, Priyanka, U. R. Acharya
pmc-13439183.description: Deep learning models for brain tumor diagnosis often lack interpretability beyond qualitative visual heatmaps. Clinicians require not only tumor localization but also quantitative assessment of explanation quality and diagnostic relevance, capabilities absent in conventional explainability methods. This paper introduces a classification-explainability framework addressing these limitations. The Multi-Level Hybrid Network (MLHnet) integrates CNN-Transformer components with multi-level attention for robust feature learning.

pmc-13476348.title: The COMT rs4680 SNP participates in the regulation of the arousal threshold in patients with obstructive sleep apnea
pmc-13476348.creator: Helena Martynowicz, Anna Jodkowska, Michał Fułek, Joanna Smardz, Marta Bort, Paweł Gać, Jakub Przegrałek, Marta Dratwa-Kuzmin, Katarzyna Bogunia-Kubik, Mieszko Więckiewicz
pmc-13476348.description: PurposeTo investigate whether the functional catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) rs4680 polymorphism is related to a predicted low respiratory arousal threshold (LAT) phenotype in adults with polysomnography-confirmed obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), and to assess selected dopaminergic pathway-related polymorphisms.MethodsIn this prospective observational study, 144 adults with OSA underwent polysomnography.
